name: DSH Turn Navigator

one_liner.zh: 为 DSH 网页长对话显示可预览、可跳转的用户轮次导航条。
one_liner.en: Adds a scroll-synced, previewable turn rail for long DSH Web conversations.

install.dsh_version: Compatible DSH Web build with the conversation.chat.navigator slot required

readme_mismatch: README describes hover preview, focus support, theme adaptation, reduced motion, and preserving position while loading older history; inspected component source confirms hover/focus previews and older-page loading but the theme, motion, and anchored position behavior are not implemented in the inspected plugin code.
README states the required conversation.chat.navigator slot is not yet declared by the pinned private SDK; the browser entry injects into that slot, so a compatible host contract is required.

completeness.reason: 按已读部分评：实现轮次筛选、预览、滚动定位与点击跳转；入口所依赖的宿主 slot 仍要求兼容 Web 端提供。

code.reason: 按已读部分评：TypeScript 组件拆分清楚，使用清理事件监听和动画帧；本次未读 CSS 与其余核心测试。

docs.reason: README 说明安装方式、宿主 slot 合同、开发步骤和已知限制，并提供使用示例。

maintenance.reason: 清单记录仅 1 次提交，且提交集中在首次创建日。

tests.reason: 有组件测试覆盖预览、阈值加载、滚动定位与跳转；事实表显示无 CI，未运行测试。

quality.notes: 质量分基于固定提交的静态阅读和清单元数据。
